verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants browse issues, inspect stack traces/event data, resolve issues, and even detect N+1 query patterns, enabling natural-language interaction via connected AI tools rather than the raw UI. However, this is entirely first-party documentation with no independent/hands-on confirmation, and the documented scope is limited to investigation/read-type operations rather than full product control via NL. Missing for 10: independent verification of the MCP server working in practice, evidence of broader write/config operations (alerts, settings) via natural language, and any non-vendor usage reports.
